voice: second person, present tense, plain; a friend explaining over messages
notes: Patterns with a slot are written with the Spanish slot name (ir a + infinitivo, no + verbo) and the example fills the slot. Examples are Spanish, then ' — ' and a short English gloss. Anti-examples name the wrong form in quotes, then the right one. Spanish inside English text is written as is, with accents; no pronunciation anywhere. Neutral Latin American usage: ustedes, no vosotros.
